rewrites.comment: Every real page is written as a file by the prerender step, so this only catches an address that has none. The exclusions keep it off the assets and off the two files a crawler asks for by name — a robots.txt that answers with the application shell is worse than none, because it looks like an answer.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
